task: Open the door, then take the box from the other room; try not to drop the key while the door is still closed.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(target_picked_up) hard with Precedence(door_open, target_picked_up) hard captures 'open the door, then take the box' (the chain also forces door_open, so no Existence(door_open) is needed), and the soft Absence(key_lost) matches 'try not to drop the key while the door is still closed' — key_lost is defined as acquiring then losing the key before the door is opened, so the 'while still closed' condition is already in the event and a plain soft Absence is the right form.

texts: Open the door before picking up the target box.
Eventually pick up the target box.
Try not to drop the matching key while the door is still closed.
